summary: Structure, file mapping and technical metadata are sound, but the female disease value 'female pattern hair loss' does not resolve to any ontology term, so ontology integrity fails.

reviewer_context.context: fresh independent reviewer subagent; no producer transcript, report.md or prior reviews read; evidence limited to scratchpad/bkk/<PXD>/ plus re-fetched PRIDE/Europe PMC/OLS/Cellosaurus

spec_compliance.evidence: Templates ms-proteomics+human (declared, v1.1.0) re-derived; 17 rows, 35 columns, no duplicate rows; validator reports only an ontology warning.

ontology_integrity.evidence: 'female pattern hair loss' (characteristics[disease], factor value[disease], rows 1-6) not found in mondo/efo/doid/ncit/pato by parse_sdrf, sdrf-tools check (flagged hallucinated) and OLS4 search. Other 13 terms verified by sdrf-tools check; scalp=UBERON:0000403, androgenetic alopecia=MONDO:0005339 resolve.

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE protocol: Q Exactive Plus, HCD NCE 27%, MS1 350-1400 m/z, DTT/IAA, trypsin 2 missed, CAM fixed / Ox M variable, Proteome Discoverer 2.1; scalp samples AGA/FPHL + normal controls. Paper (PMID 39460779, DOI 10.1007/s00403-024-03453-8) abstract consistent; full text not open access.

file_mapping.evidence: 17 SDRF data files = 17 RAW files in PRIDE files.json (projectAccessions PXD052630); no missing/extra; .mgf/.msf excluded correctly.

design_consistency.evidence: FA1-6 (6), FN1-2 (2), MA1-7 (7), MN1-2 (2); factor value[disease]/[sex] match characteristics; one run per individual, technical replicate 1, fraction 1.

omission_safety.evidence: Values trace to PRIDE protocol/abstract; tolerances and age left not available; group/sex derived from file codes (FA/FN/MA/MN) consistent with stated 2x2 design (noted as minor); developmental stage 'adult' inferred (minor).

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t human exit 0 (warnings only: disease term not in ontology list); sdrf-tools check and score run (see findings)

findings.message: 'female pattern hair loss' is free text that resolves to no ontology term.
findings.evidence: parse_sdrf warning; sdrf-tools check marks it hallucinated; OLS4 search returns no match. Paper title calls the condition 'female androgenetic alopecia'. Resolvable options: NCIT:C219942 'Female Pattern Alopecia' (defined as androgenetic alopecia in females) or MONDO:0005339 'androgenetic alopecia' (with sex already a factor).
findings.correction: Replace with an exact ontology label, e.g. 'Female Pattern Alopecia' (NCIT:C219942) or 'androgenetic alopecia' (MONDO:0005339), in both characteristics and factor value columns.

findings.message: Per-sample sex and disease are inferred from filename codes (F/M, A/N), not from a sample table.
findings.evidence: Manifest itself labels this 'Inference'; PRIDE describes AGA/FPHL patients and respective controls; paper full text not open access so group sizes (6/2/7/2) could not be confirmed.

findings.message: 'adult' is not stated in PRIDE or the abstract; it is a plausible inference for pattern hair loss patients.
findings.evidence: No age information in pride.json or abstract; age is 'not available'.

findings.message: Q Exactive Plus overrides PRIDE structured 'Q Exactive HF'; supported by the written protocol, RAW-header claim not independently re-checked (780 MB file).
findings.evidence: dataProcessingProtocol: 'Q Exactive Plus Hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap'; PRIDE instruments: MS:1002523 Q Exactive HF.
